relations.name: reporting_borrower_matrix_v3
relations.comment: R028: automatic schedule gate preserves V41 payment score and contribution. V2 retained for rollback/comparison; no borrower names or override records.
relations.view_definition:
SELECT m.borrower_id,
    m.contribution_30d,
    m.active_borrower_count,
    m.portfolio_contribution_30d,
    m.contribution_share,
    m.equal_share,
    m.relative_contribution,
    m.reliability_score,
    m.confidence,
        CASE
            WHEN s.arrangement_gate AND (m.quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Cash Cow'::text])) THEN
            CASE
                WHEN m.relative_contribution >= 1::numeric THEN 'Question Mark'::text
                ELSE 'Dog'::text
            END
            ELSE m.quadrant
        END AS quadrant,
        CASE
            WHEN s.arrangement_gate THEN 'Automatic modified-schedule rule: auto-charge off and interest amount or charge-date coverage below 80%; payment score unchanged'::text
            ELSE m.classification_reason
        END AS classification_reason,
    m.outstanding_principal,
    m.reporting_date,
    m.calculated_at,
    'borrower-matrix-v3'::text AS method_version,
    m.quadrant AS payment_only_quadrant,
    s.arrangement_status,
    s.arrangement_gate,
    s.modified_schedule_loan_count,
    s.interest_coverage_30d,
    s.interest_date_coverage_30d,
    s.arrangement_gate AND (m.quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Cash Cow'::text])) AS category_adjusted
   FROM reporting_borrower_matrix_v2 m
     JOIN reporting_borrower_schedule_health_v1 s USING (borrower_id);

relations.name: reporting_borrower_schedule_health_v1
relations.comment: R028: any active loan meeting the automatic modified-schedule rule gates upper categories; recalculated on query with no manual intervention.
relations.view_definition:
WITH a AS (
         SELECT reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.borrower_id,
            count(*)::integer AS active_loan_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.modified_schedule)::integer AS modified_schedule_loan_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.comparison_status <> 'Supported'::text)::integer AS unsupported_or_invalid_loan_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.assessment_eligible)::integer AS assessed_loan_count,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.expected_interest_30d) AS expected_interest_30d,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.recorded_interest_30d) AS recorded_interest_30d,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.recorded_principal_30d) AS recorded_principal_30d,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.expected_due_dates_30d) AS expected_due_dates_30d,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.recorded_interest_dates_30d) AS recorded_interest_dates_30d
           FROM reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.borrower_id
        )
 SELECT b."Row ID" AS borrower_id,
    COALESCE(a.active_loan_count, 0) AS active_loan_count,
    COALESCE(a.modified_schedule_loan_count, 0) AS modified_schedule_loan_count,
    COALESCE(a.unsupported_or_invalid_loan_count, 0) AS unsupported_or_invalid_loan_count,
    COALESCE(a.assessed_loan_count, 0) AS assessed_loan_count,
    a.expected_interest_30d,
    a.recorded_interest_30d,
    a.recorded_principal_30d,
    a.recorded_interest_30d / NULLIF(a.expected_interest_30d, 0::numeric) AS interest_coverage_30d,
    a.recorded_interest_dates_30d::numeric / NULLIF(a.expected_due_dates_30d, 0)::numeric AS interest_date_coverage_30d,
    COALESCE(a.modified_schedule_loan_count > 0, false) AS arrangement_gate,
        CASE
            WHEN a.modified_schedule_loan_count > 0 THEN 'Modified payment schedule'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(a.active_loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'No active loans'::text
            WHEN a.unsupported_or_invalid_loan_count > 0 THEN 'Not assessed: source/product'::text
            WHEN a.assessed_loan_count = 0 THEN 'Insufficient observation'::text
            ELSE 'No schedule restriction'::text
        END AS arrangement_status,
    olap_reporting_date() AS reporting_date,
    statement_timestamp() AS calculated_at,
    'schedule-health-v1'::text AS method_version
   FROM "Borrowers" b
     LEFT JOIN a ON a.borrower_id = b."Row ID";

relations.name: reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1
relations.comment: R028 automatic: current-terms counterfactual, 30 completed days, anchor-aware; >=7 days and >=2 due dates; auto-off plus <80% interest amount OR charge-date coverage restricts category. No manual labels. Amounts are not extra debt.
relations.view_definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d,
            statement_timestamp() AS t
        ), charge_dates AS (
         SELECT "Charges"."Ref Loans" AS loan_id,
            "Charges"."Charge Date" AS due_date,
            sum("Charges"."Interest Due"::numeric) AS interest,
            sum("Charges"."Principal Due"::numeric) AS principal,
            bool_or("Charges"."Charge Date" IS NULL OR "Charges"."Interest Due" IS NULL OR "Charges"."Principal Due" IS NULL OR "Charges"."Interest Due"::numeric < 0::numeric OR "Charges"."Principal Due"::numeric < 0::numeric) AS invalid
           FROM "Charges"
          GROUP BY "Charges"."Ref Loans", "Charges"."Charge Date"
        ), base AS (
         SELECT l."Row ID" AS loan_id,
            l."Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
            l."Loan Type" AS loan_type,
            l."Loan Date" AS start_date,
            COALESCE(l."Interest Schedule Anchor Date", l."Loan Date") AS anchor_date,
            l."Interest Payment Interval" AS payment_interval,
            l."Current Daily Interest"::numeric AS daily_interest,
            COALESCE(l."Transfer Fee"::numeric, 0::numeric) AS transfer_fee,
            COALESCE(l."Auto Charge Enabled", false) AS auto_charge_enabled,
            l."Outstanding Principal" AS outstanding_principal,
            COALESCE(l."Defaulted", false) AS defaulted,
            ctx.d AS reporting_date,
            ctx.t AS calculated_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN l."Loan Type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN 'Unsupported loan type'::text
                    WHEN l."Loan Date" IS NULL OR l."Interest Payment Interval" IS NULL OR l."Interest Payment Interval" < 1 OR l."Current Daily Interest" IS NULL OR l."Current Daily Interest"::numeric <= 0::numeric OR COALESCE(l."Interest Schedule Anchor Date", l."Loan Date") < l."Loan Date" OR COALESCE(l."Defaulted", false) THEN 'Source review'::text
                    ELSE 'Supported'::text
                END AS setup_status
           FROM "Loans" l
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text AND (l."Loan Date" <= ctx.d OR l."Loan Date" IS NULL) AND (l."Close Date" IS NULL OR l."Close Date" > ctx.d)
        ), dates AS (
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            b.borrower_id,
            b.loan_type,
            b.start_date,
            b.anchor_date,
            b.payment_interval,
            b.daily_interest,
            b.transfer_fee,
            b.auto_charge_enabled,
            b.outstanding_principal,
            b.defaulted,
            b.reporting_date,
            b.calculated_at,
            b.setup_status,
            GREATEST(b.reporting_date - 30,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.anchor_date > b.start_date THEN b.anchor_date + 1
                    ELSE b.start_date
                END) AS comparison_start,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.anchor_date > b.start_date THEN COALESCE(( SELECT max(c.due_date) AS max
                       FROM charge_dates c
                      WHERE c.loan_id = b.loan_id AND c.due_date <= b.anchor_date), b.start_date)
                    ELSE b.start_date
                END AS accrual_baseline
           FROM base b
        ), expected_dates AS (
         SELECT dates.loan_id,
            dates.start_date AS due_date,
            dates.daily_interest AS amount
           FROM dates
          WHERE dates.setup_status = 'Supported'::text AND dates.anchor_date = dates.start_date AND dates.start_date >= dates.comparison_start AND dates.start_date < dates.reporting_date
        UNION ALL
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            b.anchor_date + n.n * b.payment_interval,
            b.daily_interest *
                CASE
                    WHEN n.n = 1 THEN b.anchor_date + b.payment_interval - b.accrual_baseline
                    ELSE b.payment_interval
                END::numeric
           FROM dates b
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(GREATEST(1, ceil((b.comparison_start - b.anchor_date)::numeric / NULLIF(b.payment_interval, 0)::numeric)::integer), floor((b.reporting_date - 1 - b.anchor_date)::numeric / NULLIF(b.payment_interval, 0)::numeric)::integer) n(n)
          WHERE b.setup_status = 'Supported'::text
        ), expected AS (
         SELECT expected_dates.loan_id,
            sum(expected_dates.amount) AS expected_interest_30d,
            count(*)::integer AS expected_due_dates_30d
           FROM expected_dates
          GROUP BY expected_dates.loan_id
        ), actual AS (
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            COALESCE(sum(c.interest -
                CASE
                    WHEN c.due_date = b.start_date THEN b.transfer_fee
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.comparison_start AND c.due_date < b.reporting_date), 0::numeric) AS recorded_interest_30d,
            COALESCE(sum(c.principal) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.comparison_start AND c.due_date < b.reporting_date), 0::numeric) AS recorded_principal_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.comparison_start AND c.due_date < b.reporting_date AND (c.interest -
                CASE
                    WHEN c.due_date = b.start_date THEN b.transfer_fee
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) > 0::numeric)::integer AS recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            max(c.due_date) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date < b.reporting_date) AS last_recorded_due_date,
            min(c.due_date) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.reporting_date AND c.due_date < (b.reporting_date + 90)) AS next_plan_due_date,
            bool_or(c.invalid OR c.due_date = b.start_date AND c.interest < b.transfer_fee) AS source_invalid
           FROM dates b
             LEFT JOIN charge_dates c USING (loan_id)
          GROUP BY b.loan_id
        ), metrics AS (
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            b.borrower_id,
            b.loan_type,
            b.start_date,
            b.anchor_date,
            b.payment_interval,
            b.daily_interest,
            b.transfer_fee,
            b.auto_charge_enabled,
            b.outstanding_principal,
            b.defaulted,
            b.reporting_date,
            b.calculated_at,
            b.setup_status,
            b.comparison_start,
            b.accrual_baseline,
            GREATEST(0, b.reporting_date - b.comparison_start) AS observation_days,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.setup_status = 'Supported'::text AND NOT COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN COALESCE(e.expected_interest_30d, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expected_interest_30d,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.setup_status = 'Supported'::text AND NOT COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN a.recorded_interest_30d
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS recorded_interest_30d,
            a.recorded_principal_30d,
            COALESCE(e.expected_due_dates_30d, 0) AS expected_due_dates_30d,
            a.recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            a.last_recorded_due_date,
            a.next_plan_due_date,
            f.interest AS next_plan_interest,
            f.principal AS next_plan_principal,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN 'Source review'::text
                    ELSE b.setup_status
                END AS comparison_status
           FROM dates b
             LEFT JOIN expected e USING (loan_id)
             JOIN actual a USING (loan_id)
             LEFT JOIN charge_dates f ON f.loan_id = b.loan_id AND f.due_date = a.next_plan_due_date
        ), ratios AS (
         SELECT metrics.loan_id,
            metrics.borrower_id,
            metrics.loan_type,
            metrics.start_date,
            metrics.anchor_date,
            metrics.payment_interval,
            metrics.daily_interest,
            metrics.transfer_fee,
            metrics.auto_charge_enabled,
            metrics.outstanding_principal,
            metrics.defaulted,
            metrics.reporting_date,
            metrics.calculated_at,
            metrics.setup_status,
            metrics.comparison_start,
            metrics.accrual_baseline,
            metrics.observation_days,
            metrics.expected_interest_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_30d,
            metrics.recorded_principal_30d,
            metrics.expected_due_dates_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            metrics.last_recorded_due_date,
            metrics.next_plan_due_date,
            metrics.next_plan_interest,
            metrics.next_plan_principal,
            metrics.comparison_status,
            metrics.recorded_interest_30d / NULLIF(metrics.expected_interest_30d, 0::numeric) AS interest_coverage_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_dates_30d::numeric / NULLIF(metrics.expected_due_dates_30d, 0)::numeric AS interest_date_coverage_30d,
            metrics.comparison_status = 'Supported'::text AND metrics.observation_days >= 7 AND metrics.expected_due_dates_30d >= 2 AS assessment_eligible
           FROM metrics
        )
 SELECT loan_id,
    borrower_id,
    loan_type,
    start_date,
    anchor_date,
    payment_interval,
    daily_interest,
    transfer_fee,
    auto_charge_enabled,
    outstanding_principal,
    defaulted,
    reporting_date,
    calculated_at,
    setup_status,
    comparison_start,
    accrual_baseline,
    observation_days,
    expected_interest_30d,
    recorded_interest_30d,
    recorded_principal_30d,
    expected_due_dates_30d,
    recorded_interest_dates_30d,
    last_recorded_due_date,
    next_plan_due_date,
    next_plan_interest,
    next_plan_principal,
    comparison_status,
    interest_coverage_30d,
    interest_date_coverage_30d,
    assessment_eligible,
    COALESCE(assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8), false) AS schedule_departure,
    COALESCE(assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8) AND NOT auto_charge_enabled, false) AS modified_schedule,
        CASE
            WHEN assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8) AND NOT auto_charge_enabled THEN 'Modified payment schedule'::text
            WHEN comparison_status <> 'Supported'::text THEN comparison_status
            WHEN NOT assessment_eligible THEN 'Insufficient observation'::text
            ELSE 'No schedule restriction'::text
        END AS arrangement_status,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 AND interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Reduced/deferred interest and fewer charge dates'::text
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Reduced/deferred interest'::text
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Fewer charge dates / deferred payment frequency'::text
            WHEN comparison_status <> 'Supported'::text THEN comparison_status
            WHEN NOT assessment_eligible THEN 'At least seven observed days and two expected dates required'::text
            ELSE 'Automatic schedule rule does not restrict category'::text
        END AS schedule_reason,
    'schedule-health-v1'::text AS schedule_method_version
   FROM ratios;

        ), dates AS (
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            b.borrower_id,
            b.loan_type,
            b.start_date,
            b.anchor_date,
            b.payment_interval,
            b.daily_interest,

            b.auto_charge_enabled,

                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) > 0::numeric)::integer AS recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            max(c.due_date) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date < b.reporting_date) AS last_recorded_due_date,
            min(c.due_date) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.reporting_date AND c.due_date < (b.reporting_date + 90)) AS next_plan_due_date,
            bool_or(c.invalid OR c.due_date = b.start_date AND c.interest < b.transfer_fee) AS source_invalid
           FROM dates b
             LEFT JOIN charge_dates c USING (loan_id)
          GROUP BY b.loan_id
        ), metrics AS (
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            b.borrower_id,
            b.loan_type,
            b.start_date,
            b.anchor_date,
            b.payment_interval,
            b.daily_interest,
            b.transfer_fee,
            b.auto_charge_enabled,
            b.outstanding_principal,
            b.defaulted,
            b.reporting_date,
            b.calculated_at,
            b.setup_status,
            b.comparison_start,
            b.accrual_baseline,
            GREATEST(0, b.reporting_date - b.comparison_start) AS observation_days,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.setup_status = 'Supported'::text AND NOT COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN COALESCE(e.expected_interest_30d, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expected_interest_30d,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.setup_status = 'Supported'::text AND NOT COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN a.recorded_interest_30d
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS recorded_interest_30d,
            a.recorded_principal_30d,
            COALESCE(e.expected_due_dates_30d, 0) AS expected_due_dates_30d,
            a.recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            a.last_recorded_due_date,
            a.next_plan_due_date,
            f.interest AS next_plan_interest,
            f.principal AS next_plan_principal,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN 'Source review'::text
                    ELSE b.setup_status
                END AS comparison_status
           FROM dates b
             LEFT JOIN expected e USING (loan_id)
             JOIN actual a USING (loan_id)
             LEFT JOIN charge_dates f ON f.loan_id = b.loan_id AND f.due_date = a.next_plan_due_date
        ), ratios AS (
         SELECT metrics.loan_id,
            metrics.borrower_id,
            metrics.loan_type,
            metrics.start_date,
            metrics.anchor_date,
            metrics.payment_interval,
            metrics.daily_interest,
            metrics.transfer_fee,
            metrics.auto_charge_enabled,
            metrics.outstanding_principal,
            metrics.defaulted,
            metrics.reporting_date,
            metrics.calculated_at,
            metrics.setup_status,
            metrics.comparison_start,
            metrics.accrual_baseline,
            metrics.observation_days,
            metrics.expected_interest_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_30d,
            metrics.recorded_principal_30d,
            metrics.expected_due_dates_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            metrics.last_recorded_due_date,
            metrics.next_plan_due_date,
            metrics.next_plan_interest,
            metrics.next_plan_principal,
            metrics.comparison_status,
            metrics.recorded_interest_30d / NULLIF(metrics.expected_interest_30d, 0::numeric) AS interest_coverage_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_dates_30d::numeric / NULLIF(metrics.expected_due_dates_30d, 0)::numeric AS interest_date_coverage_30d,
            metrics.comparison_status = 'Supported'::text AND metrics.observation_days >= 7 AND metrics.expected_due_dates_30d >= 2 AS assessment_eligible
           FROM metrics
        )
 SELECT loan_id,
    borrower_id,
    loan_type,
    start_date,
    anchor_date,
    payment_interval,
    daily_interest,
    transfer_fee,
    auto_charge_enabled,
    outstanding_principal,
    defaulted,
    reporting_date,
    calculated_at,
    setup_status,
    comparison_start,
    accrual_baseline,
    observation_days,
    expected_interest_30d,
    recorded_interest_30d,
    recorded_principal_30d,
    expected_due_dates_30d,
    recorded_interest_dates_30d,
    last_recorded_due_date,
    next_plan_due_date,
    next_plan_interest,
    next_plan_principal,
    comparison_status,
    interest_coverage_30d,
    interest_date_coverage_30d,
    assessment_eligible,
    COALESCE(assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8), false) AS schedule_departure,
    COALESCE(assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8) AND NOT auto_charge_enabled, false) AS modified_schedule,
        CASE
            WHEN assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8) AND NOT auto_charge_enabled THEN 'Modified payment schedule'::text
            WHEN comparison_status <> 'Supported'::text THEN comparison_status
            WHEN NOT assessment_eligible THEN 'Insufficient observation'::text
            ELSE 'No schedule restriction'::text
        END AS arrangement_status,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 AND interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Reduced/deferred interest and fewer charge dates'::text
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Reduced/deferred interest'::text
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Fewer charge dates / deferred payment frequency'::text
            WHEN comparison_status <> 'Supported'::text THEN comparison_status
            WHEN NOT assessment_eligible THEN 'At least seven observed days and two expected dates required'::text
            ELSE 'Automatic schedule rule does not restrict category'::text
        END AS schedule_reason,
    'schedule-health-v1'::text AS schedule_method_version
   FROM ratios;
